description: Token info and total supply for any ERC20 on Ethereum, Base, Arc or BNB Chain: name, symbol, decimals, total supply. $0.001 per call over x402 (USDC on Arc, Base or Solana, or XNT on X1). Call once without `payment` for the terms, sign them with your own wallet, call again with `payment`.

payment.description: a signed x402 payment (the base64 payload you would put in PAYMENT-SIGNATURE). Pass it and the purchase completes inside this tool call.

name: evm_token_info
